args.title: Document local MinIO setup and S3_ENDPOINT in README
args.body:
File: README.md

Add S3_ENDPOINT environment variable configuration and MinIO bucket creation steps to the Running locally section so local uploads correctly target MinIO instead of AWS S3.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The README lacks instructions for setting S3_ENDPOINT and configuring the bucket when running locally with MinIO, which this documentation update provides.
